name: Awakened Beauty
source:
After breaking into the Palace of Luster, you come across Princess Celeste Lucente. She was cursed to slumber for eternity a century ago. Cursed until you kissed her.

Upon waking her up, she isn't too happy. She has been asleep for a century, after all.

[from [url=https://liminace.itch.io/awakened-beauty]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
闯入光辉宫殿后，你遇到了塞莱斯特·卢森特公主。一个世纪前，她被诅咒永远沉睡。咒骂直到你吻了她。

叫醒她后，她不太高兴。毕竟她已经睡了一个世纪了。

[来自[url=https://liminace.itch.io/awakened-beauty]itch.io[/url]]
